desc: Ideate approaches and select min-heap boundary expansion as the primary method.
Parse input, convert starting coordinates to zero-based indexing, and store the grid efficiently.
Initialize current strength from the starting cell, mark it visited, and push its unvisited neighbors into a min-heap keyed by strength.

Implement the main expansion loop: pop the weakest frontier cell, skip if already visited, absorb it only if `current_strength > X * strength`, update strength, mark visited, and push unvisited neighbors.
Ensure duplicate heap entries are safely ignored and use integer arithmetic for the strict inequality.
Print the final strength and verify against sample cases and edge cases.
